8115.title: Selected plugin installs materialize unrelated files
8115.rootCauseOneLine: The server performs an unrestricted checkout before resolving the selected plugin subdirectory.

prReviews.topFinding: Selection-aware checkout targets the verified ordering error; runtime behavior unverified.
Earlier sparse-checkout proposal; not a fix on main.

8115.proposedFix: Resolve the plugin selection before full-tree materialization; preserve root, fallback, symlink and shared-cache behavior. Existing open PR #8116 already links this issue.
8115.caveats: Service-level fixture only; no macOS timing or remote blob-transfer benchmark. Test patch and observations are inline per reports repository policy.
